Paws United Dog Rescue is a registered charity based out of foster homes in the London and Strathroy area.  We work with local animal shelters and IFAW to place dogs in loving foster homes in preparation for finding their forever homes.  Many of our dogs have been medical cases requiring extensive vet work.

Please visit our website paws-united.com or email paws-united@live.ca for more information!
